high_level_description: stc brand style, a corporate signing ceremony photograph of Arab executives in traditional white thobes seated at an stc-branded reception desk.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A minimalist modern office with white walls, gray carpeting, a large curved screen behind the desk, and two black security cameras mounted on the walls, lit brightly and evenly.

elements.desc: Two Arab men in traditional white thobes and ghutra headscarves seated at a white reception-style desk in the center.
Five Arab men in traditional white thobes and ghutra standing behind the seated pair.
A modern white reception-style desk with a clean, minimalist design.
The company logo displayed in purple on the front of the desk.
A repeating pattern of the company logo shown in teal and white across the large curved background screen.
